basic_info.description: Introducing a prime investment opportunity! This charming fully occupied 4-unit building in Corona Heights offers spacious 1BD/1BA units with high ceilings, hardwood floors, views, and two garage spaces (one vacant). Each unit is well-maintained and in good condition providing peace of mind to investors and a comfortable living environment for the tenants. Ideally located close to public transportation ensuring convenient access to city life while remaining a peaceful retreat. A rare find, pride of ownership building. Don't miss this opportunity to add it to your portfolio.
